text:
This website hosts the results of VIBE, the Vector Index Benchmark for Embeddings. Use its interactive plots to explore the benchmark results.



Explore the results


 Overview Compare every algorithm across all datasets at a glance.   Datasets Explore the datasets, embeddings, dimensions, and distance measures.   Tradeoffs Examine the tradeoff between recall and query throughput.   Algorithm focus Inspect every configuration tested for each algorithm.   Robustness Investigate how algorithms respond to query difficulty. 




Run VIBE


The benchmark code and instructions for running it are available on GitHub.




Extend VIBE


Interested in contributing? Follow the guide for adding a new method.

title: VIBE: Vector Index Benchmark for Embeddings
text:
This page allows to select, for each dataset, a recall threshold. Then, for each algorithm, the fastest configuration achieving an average recall larger than the threshold is automatically selected.
We then consider two groups of queries:

the 100 queries with smallest relative contrast, deemed  difficult
the 100 queries with largest relative contrast, deemed  easy 

The plot below report the average recall attained by each algorithm on both groups, under the aforementioned configuration.

db = DuckDBClient.of({
  stats: FileAttachment("results/stats.parquet"),
  summary: FileAttachment("results/summary.parquet"),
  basics: {file: FileAttachment("dataset_basics.csv"), header: true},
  algorithm_basics: {file: FileAttachment("algorithms_basics.csv"), header: true}
})

datasets = db.sql`select distinct dataset from summary where dataset not like '%-id-%' order by all;`
















viewof selected_dataset = Inputs.select(datasets.map(d => d.dataset))
k_value = 100
viewof recall_threshold = Inputs.range([0,1], {step: 0.01, value: 0.9, label: "minimum recall"});























focus_url = `${window.location.origin}${window.location.pathname.slice(0, -"robustness.html".length)}results/${selected_dataset}__detail.parquet`;







stats = db.sql`
WITH
  query_ranks AS (
    select 
      query_index, 
      rc100, 
      rank() over (order by rc100) as query_rank,
    from stats where dataset = ${selected_dataset}),
  query_type AS (
    select
      query_index,
      rc100,
      case when query_rank < 100 then 'difficult' when query_rank >= 900 then 'easy' end as query_type
    from query_ranks
  )
SELECT * from query_type where query_type in ('difficult', 'easy')
`







selected = db.query(`
  with
    normalized_names as (
      select k, dataset, algorithm, params, qps, recall from summary
    ),
    filtered_summary as (
      select * from normalized_names natural left join algorithm_basics
    ),
    ranked as (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by algorithm, dataset order by qps desc) as rank
        from filtered_summary
        where recall >= ?3 and k = ?2
          and dataset = ?1 
    ),
    params as (
      select algorithm, params from ranked where rank = 1
    ),
    query_ranks AS (
      select 
        query_index, 
        rc100, 
        rank() over (order by rc100) as query_rank,
      from stats where dataset = ?1),
    query_type AS (
      select
        query_index,
        rc100,
        case when query_rank < 100 then 'difficult' when query_rank >= 900 then 'easy' end as query_type
      from query_ranks
    ),
    query_perf AS (
      select * from '${focus_url}' natural join params where dataset = ?1 and k = ?2
    )
    select algorithm, query_type, avg(recall) as recall
    from query_perf natural join query_type
    where query_type in ('difficult', 'easy')
    group by all
`, [selected_dataset, k_value, recall_threshold])







Plot.plot({
  width: width,
  style: {
    fontSize: "13pt"
  },
  axis: null,
  marginRight: 200,
  marginLeft: 60,
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleX([recall_threshold], {stroke: "lightgray"}),
    Plot.link(selected, Plot.groupY(
      {
        x1: (D) => d3.min(D),
        x2: (D) => d3.max(D)
      },
      {
        y: "algorithm",
        x1: "recall",
        x2: "recall"
      }
    )),
    Plot.dot(selected, {
      x: "recall", 
      y: "algorithm", 
      fill: "query_type",
      r: 5,
      sort: {y: "-x"}
    }),
    Plot.text(selected, Plot.groupY(
      {
        x: D => d3.max(D),
        text: D => D[0],
      },
      {
        y: "algorithm",
        x: "recall",
        text: "algorithm",
        dx: 70,
        textAnchor: "start",
        lineAnchor: "middle"
      }
    )),
    Plot.text(selected, Plot.groupY(
      {
        x: D => d3.min(D),
        text: D => d3.format(".3f")(d3.min(D)),
      },
      {
        y: "algorithm",
        x: "recall",
        text: "recall",
        dx: -10,
        textAnchor: "end"
      }
    )),
    Plot.text(selected, Plot.groupY(
      {
        x: D => d3.max(D),
        text: D => d3.format(".3f")(d3.max(D)),
      },
      {
        y: "algorithm",
        x: "recall",
        text: "recall",
        dx: 10,
        textAnchor: "start"
      }
    )),
  ]
})
